notes:
Notes: the opacity and width arrows now change the note as you press them, and the value is kept.
Copy and paste notes with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V, or Copy on a note's right-click menu and Paste on the drawing's.
A note's right-click menu has Copy Format, Paste Format and Format Painter, as in Bluebeam. The Format Painter gives the format to each note you click until you press Esc or click empty drawing.
Claude can give notes another note's format too.
